# Traceability Matrix

**Status:** Structural stub — populated as features complete their validation cycle through the agentic framework
**Format:** Markdown (was previously a placeholder `.xlsx` file — deprecated 2026-05-16)
**Generation:** This matrix will be auto-generated by `tools/traceability.py` once Phase 3 of the framework build is complete. See [`00_Project_Context/Agentic_Framework_Design.md`](../00_Project_Context/Agentic_Framework_Design.md) §9 for the design of the Python tooling layer.

---

## Purpose

The traceability matrix links every requirement through every downstream artifact: URS → FRS → DS → OQ Protocol → OQ Execution. Each row traces one requirement across the full validation chain. The matrix is the canonical evidence of validation coverage and is the first artifact a regulator queries.

In a GAMP 5 validation package, the traceability matrix answers two questions per row:
1. **Coverage** — is every URS item realised in FRS, DS, and OQ?
2. **Test evidence** — is every OQ test linked to a requirement (no orphan tests, no untested requirements)?

---

## Intended Structure

| URS ID | URS Description | FRS ID(s) | DS ID(s) | OQ Test Case ID(s) | Last Execution Result | Last Execution Date | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| _(populated per feature)_ | | | | | | | |

---

## Per-Feature Matrices

Each feature folder will contain its own `Traceability_Matrix_<feature>.md` produced by the Orchestrator when the OQ Protocol phase completes. This top-level matrix consolidates across all features.

**Features with matrices to be produced (current):**
- `01_Login/` — to be generated by the agentic framework
- `02_Logout/` — to be generated by the agentic framework
- `03_<next_feature>/` — Phase 5 of the build plan

---

## Why Markdown, Not Spreadsheet

The previous artifact was a binary `.xlsx` file (with an accidental double extension: `Traceability_Matrix.xlsx.xlsx`). Markdown was chosen for the agentic framework because:

1. **Diffable** — every change is reviewable in version control. Spreadsheet diffs are opaque.
2. **Parseable** — the Python tooling layer can validate matrix rows against the actual artifact IDs in URS/FRS/DS/OQ files.
3. **Consistent with the rest of the repo** — every validation artifact in this repository is Markdown for the same reasons.

The deprecated `.xlsx.xlsx` file is retained alongside (renamed `.deprecated`) as a marker for reviewers who may wonder about the historical structure.
